The present application has been moved by the applicant under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure apprehending arrest under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(e) and Sec. 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 registered vide C.R. No. 804 of 2021 with Solapur Police Station, District-Solapur.

4 Heard learned Counsel for the applicant and learned APP.
5
It appears that the applicant was found in possession Gutka,/Mava/Essence Tobacco/Essence Supari.
However, having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, prima facie applicability of Section 328 of the IPC appears to be doubtful.
The applicant therefore has made out a case for ad-interim protection.

Hence, the following order is passed as an ad-interim measure:
 ORDER (i) In the event of arrest of the applicant Khalid Hamid Hatture in C.R. No. 804 of 2021 registered with Solapur Taluka Police Station, Solapur for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272,
273, 328 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(e) and Sec. 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, he be enlarged on bail on his furnishing PR and SB in the sum of Rs.20,000/-
02-aba-2761-2021.odt with one or two sureties in like amount.
(ii) The applicant shall not tamper with prosecution evidence.
(iii) Issue notice to the concerned police station, returnable on 11th January, 2022.
